tools_used: curl official Supreme Court rules index
urllib and pypdf official rules extraction
helpful: The readable petition and extracted questions permit distinguishing asserted national stakes from the concrete licensing dispute.
Frozen sal-v4 context plus unrounded reached-band rates permits a correctly weighted prior-Term anchor.
gaps: Lower-court order text would clarify whether the federal question was reached and the nature of any procedural obstacle.
Web search/open returned no usable content; direct official-source extraction worked.
The default uv cache is read-only; a temporary cache override was needed.
notes: No case-specific external retrieval or corpus query was necessary. pdftotext was absent, but the installed pypdf library extracted the general rules without writing a downloaded file. The missing BIO was not treated as evidence that respondents waived a response.
